sign_and_trades.terms: Spotrac lists $88M in salary if the final-year player option is exercised. A trade bonus was also reported. Outgoing matching salary is inferred from half the new starting pay.

sign_and_trades.sender_reason: Denver took a first-round pick, a second-round pick and Julian Reese in place of a richer Watson contract.
